Pricing FAQ

When are fees charged?

Fees are only charged when a task is successfully completed and payment is released. No upfront costs or monthly subscriptions.

How do I qualify for lower fees?

Workers can qualify for lower fees by maintaining high ratings and completing more tasks. Employers can access better rates by successfully completing projects and building a good reputation.

Are there any hidden fees?

No hidden fees. All costs are clearly displayed before any transaction. The only additional fees are standard payment processing charges from payment providers.

Can I change my plan?

Plan upgrades are automatic based on your activity and performance. There's no need to manually change plans - you'll automatically benefit from lower fees as you qualify.
